Case study
Clara books, then doesn't turn up
Martin Kerr sells a 60-minute strategy session with a $50.00 no-show fee. Follow Clara's booking from the card she leaves to the fee Martin collects after Thursday's empty call.
Payments & Seats
Martin sets a fee instead of a price
He picks Stripe, enters $50.00 and sets the payment option to Charge no-show fee. He also charges cancellations made in the last 24 hours.
Payment
Clara leaves a card, not money
After she picks Thursday at 10:00am, she types her card, ticks that she'll pay $50.00 if she misses the call, and presses Submit card.
Bookings
The booking says Card held
The session sits in Martin's Upcoming like any other. The badge tells him a card is on file and nothing has been charged.
After event
Thursday at 10:00, nobody joins
Martin opens the booking's menu in Past and picks Mark as no-show. Clara's name gets the no-show mark, and the fee is still uncharged.
Charge card
Martin charges the card she left
Collect no-show fee asks him to confirm the $50.00. Stripe charges Clara's card, and she gets an email saying what the fee was for.

Questions about no-show fees
When the card is charged, who decides, and what isn't supported.
Ask a question
Is the booker charged when they book?
No. They enter their card and agree to the fee, and Stripe saves it. The booking shows Card held until you charge it.
Is the fee charged automatically when someone doesn't show?
No. After the meeting you open the booking in Past and pick Collect no-show fee, then confirm the amount. Marking someone as a no-show doesn't charge them by itself.
What about last-minute cancellations?
Turn on Auto charge no-show fee for last minute cancellations and set a window in minutes, hours or days. A booker who cancels inside it has to agree to the fee to cancel, and it's charged straight away. Cancellations before the window are free.
What if I cancel the booking myself?
The fee isn't charged. Cancellations by the host, or by a team admin or owner, skip it.
Which payment app does it work with?
Stripe. Connect it, turn on Paid booking on the link's Payments & Seats tab, and set the payment option to Charge no-show fee.
Can I use it with seats or recurring events?
Not yet. A link can't offer seats and charge a no-show fee, and payments don't support recurring events.
